description: Search and filter the directory of affiliate programs (each compared by network, commission, cookie window, and a MODELLED value per referral). Use to answer 'best/highest-paying affiliate programs for X', or to find programs by category, network, recurring vs one-time, or minimum value. Returns a ranked, paginated list.

category.description: Category key, e.g. saas, finance, hosting, crypto (see list_categories).

confidence.description: confirmed = rate read on the brand's own page.

min_value.description: Minimum modelled value per referral in USD.

network.description: Primary network bucket, e.g. Impact, CJ, Awin, In-house (see list_networks).

q.description: Free-text match on name, network, category, commission.

recurring.description: true = only recurring-commission programs; false = only one-time.

name: search_affiliate_programs
